description: NaCaHSiO₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.90 Å. Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent CaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.44 Å. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent CaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-55°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.69 Å. H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.04 Å) and one longer (1.49 Å) H-O bond length. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ca, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Ca, and one Si atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaCa₂Si tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Si, and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Si, and one H atom.
